reason: Primary purpose is an agent-facing scholarly literature utility: a DeepSeek Harness plugin adapter that enables search, retrieval, and citation-audit workflows over many academic sources. Conservatively, capabilities include multi-source bibliographic search, PDF/supplement download, manuscript reference verification, result export, and workflow automation. A human check is needed due optional paywall-bypass-style fallback download paths.

capabilities: Academic literature search across many external sources
Citation extraction and verification for manuscript files
Bulk retrieval, deduplication, and ranking workflows
